title: My first jam game: a browser spinning-top roguelite built with an agentic MCP stack — Claude Code → Godot, Blender MCP → models, Ableton MCP → soundtrack.
author: Hyphysaurusrex
selftext:
KOMA — Super Spinning Top · Beyblade meets a roguelite gauntlet, playable in your browser.  
[https://hyphysaurus.itch.io/koma-super-spinning-top](https://hyphysaurus.itch.io/koma-super-spinning-top)

**HOW TO PLAY:**

Hold to charge, release to RIP, be the last top spinning. You pick a top (Attack / Defense / Stamina), drop into a packed broadcast "beystadium" for a free-for-all, win the bout, spin the Wheel of Destiny for a roguelite upgrade, and climb the federation ladder until something at the top of the bracket refuses to stop spinning. Made solo for The Very Serious Juniper Dev Game Jam — my first-ever jam submission.

**The AI stack**

\- Game code → Claude Code + Godot MCP. All the GDScript (combat referee, roguelite economy, the run manager) was written with an AI coding assistant driving the Godot editor — editing scenes, running headless test suites, and smoke-booting scenes to catch parse errors. 37 unit tests, validated headless from WSL.

\- The visuals are 100% procedural code, no asset packs. The cel/toon look, the broadcast stadium, a \~760-instance crowd in a single draw call, sweeping spotlights, the Wheel, the Tron-style HUD, every impact effect — all generated in code + shaders. No sprite kit, no image files for the presentation. 

\- Top models DALL E Prompt Concept Aart goes through the Blender MCP and dropped neatly into Godot via the Godot MCP. 

\- Soundtrack → Ableton MCP. The battle & title themes are arcade-synthwave, composed in Ableton Live with AI-assisted arrangement via the Ableton MCP (it scaffolds the arrangement, I produce/finish). Crowd murmur, cheers, and the wheel's riser/jackpot are procedural DSP synthesized in code.

Feedback I'd love: does the rip/charge feel good in-browser? Is the combat readable at a glance? And for the MCP folks — anyone else orchestrating Blender/Ableton/engine from one agent? What's your setup?
